items.title: 独家丨前美团外卖技术负责人入局餐饮具身模型，「元节智能」获千万级种子轮融资
items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网独家获悉，具身智能初创公司「元节智能（AtomBite.AI）」已于近期完成千万级种子轮融资。本轮由英诺科创基金领投，水木清华校友种子基金、知名投资人个人跟投。据悉，本轮融资将主要用于餐饮场景具身世界模型研发、核心产品打磨及落地。 今年3月底元节智能才在苏州注册成立，成立不到两个月即完成首轮融资，同时已获得了国内外多家头部公司产品合作部署意向。据了解，企业核心团队汇聚了来自清华、中科大、美团、地平线等顶尖高校与科技公司的研发负责人及精锐人才，团队背景实力雄厚。   01 清华博士+美团产研班底   元节智能创始人兼CEO王栋博士师从中国人工智能泰斗、清华大学张钹院士，深耕人工智能领域十余年，兼具算法研究与商业场景落地的经验。   学术上，王栋在博士期间深耕人工智能表示问题，并在AI与机器人领域顶会持续发表高水平论文。2011年，他搭建出全球首个商用视频人脸识别与跟踪系统；此后，他又构建出业界领先的本地生活服务推荐系统及移动原生广告平台，将前沿的AI技术与复杂的商业场景深度融合。   联合创始人李滔曾执掌美团外卖算法与数据体系，是少数真正跑通“全链路数据算法驱动”的实战型技术负责人；同为联创的李浩哲为连续创业者，具备多年全球化商业落地能力，为团队注入强大的商业化基因。   王栋身上最核心的标签，是前美团外卖事业部技术负责人。在美团期间，他长期管理千人产研团队，主导构建了支撑日均数千万订单的外卖算法、数据与系统架构。十年外卖一线的实战，让他对餐饮外卖场景的商家痛点、运营链路与规模化路径有着深刻的理解，并曾针对商家痛点研制过多款智能硬件产品成功部署。王栋的背景，让元节智能在出发的第一天就具备了极强的产业体感。   离开美团后，王栋在北美与新加坡进行了多轮的持续数月的市场考察，走访大量餐饮商家，调研各方

excerpt_i18n.en:
Lei Feng exclusively learned that embodied intelligence startup AtomBite.AI has recently completed a seed round of tens of millions of yuan. This round was led by Inno Science and Technology Innovation Fund, with follow-on investments from Tsinghua SEM Alumni Seed Fund and well-known individual investors. The funds will primarily be used for developing embodied world models for dining scenarios, refining core products, and deployment.

AtomBite.AI was registered and established in Suzhou at the end of March this year, completing its first financing round in less than two months. It has already secured product collaboration and deployment intentions from leading domestic and international companies. The core team includes R&D leaders and top talents from prestigious universities and tech companies such as Tsinghua University, USTC, Meituan, and Horizon Robotics, boasting a strong team background.

01 Tsinghua PhD + Meituan R&D Team

Founder and CEO Dr. Wang Dong studied under China's AI pioneer, Academician Zhang Bo of Tsinghua University. With over a decade in AI, he combines algorithm research with commercial application experience.

Academically, Dr. Wang focused on AI representation during his PhD and consistently published high-level papers at top AI and robotics conferences. In 2011, he built the world's first commercial video facial recognition and tracking system. Later, he developed industry-leading local life service recommendation systems and mobile native advertising platforms, deeply integrating cutting-edge AI with complex commercial scenarios.

Co-founder Li Tao previously led Meituan's food delivery algorithm and data systems.
excerpt_i18n.es: Lei Feng Net ha sabido en exclusiva que la startup de inteligencia encarnada "AtomBite.AI" ha completado recientemente una ronda de financiación semilla de varios millones de yuanes. Esta ronda ha sido liderada por Inno Science and Technology Innovation Fund, con la participación del fondo de semillas de antiguos alumnos de Shuimu Tsinghua y un inversor particular conocido. Según se informa, los fondos se destinarán principalmente al desarrollo del modelo mundial encarnado para el sector de la restauración, el pulido del producto principal y su implementación. AtomBite.AI se registró y fundó en Suzhou a finales de marzo de este año, y completó su primera ronda de financiación en menos de dos meses desde su creación, además de haber obtenido ya intenciones de cooperación para el despliegue de productos de varias empresas líderes nacionales e internacionales. Se sabe que el equipo central de la empresa está formado por profesionales de universidades y empresas tecnológicas de primer nivel como Tsinghua, la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología de China, Meituan y Horizon Robotics.
